Browse the dashboard for projects matching your profile (pay, $/hr and minutes shown).
Complete the study carefully (attention checks are enforced).
Cash out from the payout center once your balance reaches $1 (PayPal, bank or Amazon).

maximize: Complete every screener on CloudResearch Connect honestly and fully — matching depends on it. Studies pay an average of $10/hour; pass attention checks so work is approved and paid. Cash out from just $1 via PayPal, bank transfer, or Amazon gift card. Check the dashboard daily since project availability is sporadic, and prioritize higher-pay studies because some can be completed in as little as 2 minutes.
who_pays: CloudResearch Connect pays you through its Payout Center — earnings accrue per approved study and you cash out from a $1 balance.
who_qualifies: 18+, primarily US; you must pass account verification (up to 3 business days).
work_available: Sporadic — the dashboard shows projects matching your profile, but dry spells of several days are common and availability is not guaranteed.
what_gets_accepted: Complete the study carefully — failed attention checks mean no payment. Some projects add screeners before you can start.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join, no fees. Unpaid time: account verification (up to 3 business days), screeners on some projects, and time checking a sporadic dashboard.
when_cash_arrives: After your study is approved, cash out from a $1 balance via PayPal, bank transfer or Amazon gift card.
